rows.source: Crash report Python-2026-09-21-142852.ips (EXC_BAD_ACCESS KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS 0x18 in libKGENCompilerRTShared from algenta_runtime_execute); Modular source Mojo/lib/CompilerRT/AsyncRT.cpp + Mojo/stdlib/std/builtin/_startup.mojo; scratch fix1_test.py on an ad-hoc normk+gemm library

Fix (abi.mojo _ensure_cpu_device, ABI 4.9): get-or-create the device in init and execute. Measured after the fix: rmsnorm/layernorm/sgemm return results from the main thread, from foreign threads, and when the first call is on a foreign thread; 64x512 rmsnorm with multiple workers ok; 40k foreign-thread calls RSS 27.7 -> 28.6 -> 28.6 MB (stable). Nothing in mojo/engine changed.
